name: NeurMiPs
aliases: Neural Mixture of Planar Experts for View Synthesis
definition: A view synthesis method representing a scene as a mixture of K rectangular planar surfaces, where each surface has an associated neural radiance field predicting view-dependent color and transparency.
summary: NeurMiPs represents 3D scenes as learnable planar experts, solving MPI limitations and NeRF blurring by combining explicit geometry with implicit appearance for superior extrapolation and real-time rendering.
